subject: English
central_question: How can resilience, sport, inclusion and supportive communities challenge stereotypes and expand what people believe is possible?
in_scope_units: Reflect and Respond on para-sport and Sheetal Devi
Reading for Meaning: Paralympics and the interview with Dr. Deepa Malik
Dr. Maliks journey from spinal tumour and paralysis to para-athletics, medals and public recognition
Her views on resilience, ability beyond disability, stereotypes, inclusivity, accessibility and advocacy
Check Your Understanding and Critical Reflection on fact-opinion, cause-effect, attitude and social impact
Vocabulary and Structures in Context: phrases, movement cline, modal auxiliaries and reported speech
Listening on inclusion, formal and informal interviewing, notice writing and Learning Beyond the Text on Paralympics
Reading for Appreciation: Nine Gold Medals and its themes of empathy, collective support and Special Olympics
banned_topics: Medical or sporting facts about Dr. Deepa Malik not included in the supplied text
Current Paralympic records, medal tables or biographies from outside the source

known_pitfalls.claim: The interview presents disability as a reason to lower expectations.
known_pitfalls.correction: Dr. Malik repeatedly argues that physical limitations do not define potential and uses the phrase ability beyond disability.

known_pitfalls.claim: Dr. Maliks achievements are shown as purely individual.
known_pitfalls.correction: She explicitly credits family support alongside her own fortitude and advocates wider systems of inclusion and opportunity.

known_pitfalls.claim: Paralympics and Special Olympics are treated as the same event.
known_pitfalls.correction: The Learning Beyond section distinguishes Paralympics for para-athletes from Special Olympics for children and adults with intellectual disabilities.

known_pitfalls.claim: Nine Gold Medals celebrates winning by defeating competitors.
known_pitfalls.correction: The poem celebrates the runners who stop to help a fallen athlete and cross the finish together.

recommended_example_progression: Check Your Understanding: distinguish fact-opinion from cause-effect in the interview
Critical Reflection: interpret ability beyond disability and changing perceptions
Vocabulary and Structures in Context: identify functions of modal auxiliaries
Reported speech task: convert interview statements while preserving meaning
Nine Gold Medals: explain why the race changes from individual competition to collective achievement
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The interview is followed by Check Your Understanding and Critical Reflection, then vocabulary, grammar, listening, interviewing, notice writing and Learning Beyond the Text; Nine Gold Medals has its own appreciation and reflection tasks.
